test_command: cd <worktree>; NOT_CRAN=true OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 JULIA_NUM_THREADS=1 Rscript -e 'suppressMessages(devtools::load_all(".", quiet=TRUE)); res <- testthat::test_file("tests/testthat/test-nbinom2-relmat-spatial-intercept-sd-regression.R", reporter="summary"); ...' > docs/dev-log/general-sd-regression/evidence/nbinom2-relmat-spatial-intercept-sd-r2-20261101/test-console.log

result.note: Expectation count is the observed testthat count from this fresh run; earlier ledger text quoted a different count for an earlier version of the test file.

oracle: Dense Laplace approximation of the marginal likelihood evaluated at the fitted parameters, computed in the test (Newton inner loop on the full Sigma). Independence: partly independent of the engine (separate dense implementation, no TMB), but the spatial oracle and data-generating covariance use drmTMB:::drm_spatial_coords_precision (the helper under test), checked only against a kernel rebuilt with the same formula (mirrored); the relmat kernel is analytic and independent.
tolerances_copied_from_test: dense-Laplace match 1e-6 (relative); prediction identity 1e-10; constant-SD equivalence logLik 2e-5, mu coefficients 1e-4, log SD 1e-4; kernel rebuild 1e-8; positional relmat kernel differs by >0.2, positional spatial precision by >0.5; positional oracle logLik differs by >1000 x (1e-6 x |logLik|); loose SD recovery bands as in the test
scope: Native NB2 mu relmat(1 | id, K = K) with sd(id, level='relmat') ~ z and spatial(1 | site, coords = coords) with sd(site, level='spatial') ~ z (log link). K covariance input only: no Q fit in this file (not tested, not fenced). Also refusal of a z that varies within a relmat level.
limits: fixed-seed fixtures with loose recovery bands where applicable
